status: accepted by the user on 2026-10-28 as the working geometry. Measured by eye from phone photos (SDR chart, Kodi Normal view, zoom 1.0). HDR10 was not measured separately; a straight-on re-check was not done

measured.method: cal_sdr_2160p.mkv row chart, 4 px row pitch, labels cut by the screen edge; two wide and four close-up photos
measured.note: Top: first full label at the edge is 288; 256-268 partly cut. Bottom: label 1892 whole, 1896 slightly clipped, 1900 to 1912 progressively clipped. L0-L120 and R0-R120 all visible, white frame border visible on both sides.

design_band.rationale: The nominal 2.35:1 band is inside the measured band even at the worst ends of the tolerances (258+4=262 <= 263; 1901-3=1898 >= 1897), so fitting to it cannot spill past the screen edge. The 2.35 ratio frame border (rows 263 to 1896) was seen on all four screen edges.
